questions.q: How many separate objects does this lesson import into Power BI, compared to the Beginner project?
options: One, exactly like the Beginner project
Three (Fact, ProductDim, TerritoryDim), versus one flat query result in the Beginner project
Zero — this project connects directly without importing anything
Five, one for every original AdventureWorks2012 table
questions.explain: This project imports the three staged views as separate tables so Power BI's relationship engine can connect them.

questions.q: What does marking the Date table as the model's official date table enable?
options: It has no real effect on anything
DAX time-intelligence functions like DATEADD compute correctly
Automatic translation of column names to other languages
Faster Power Query refreshes
questions.explain: Skipping this step causes time-intelligence measures to silently compute incorrect results.

questions.q: What cardinality should the Fact-to-ProductDim relationship use?
options: Many-to-one, since many fact rows can share one product
One-to-one, since each row is unique
It doesn't matter for this model
Many-to-many, since products can repeat
questions.explain: Many order-line rows in Fact can reference the same ProductID, making this a many-to-one relationship.

questions.q: Which direction should the cross-filter arrows point on all three relationships in this model?
options: Direction doesn't apply to Power BI relationships
Single-direction, from Fact toward the dimension table
Single-direction, from the dimension table toward Fact
Bidirectional (Both), on every relationship
questions.explain: The standard star-schema setup filters from dimension to fact; this project doesn't need bidirectional filtering.

questions.q: Why does getting these relationships right matter for Lessons 6-8?
options: It only affects how the model looks visually in Model view
It has no effect on DAX measures, only on refresh speed
Relationships can be changed freely later with zero downstream impact
Every DAX measure and every visual on both report pages depends on these relationships filtering correctly
questions.explain: Slicers and measures rely on the dimension-to-fact relationships to filter correctly; getting them wrong here undermines everything built on top.
